newsitem.title: FRANCE: Framatome no comment on results report.
newsitem.headline: Framatome no comment on results report.

text.p: French nuclear engineering company Framatome refused to comment on Monday on a newspaper report it earned 996 million francs in 1996.

Financial daily Les Echos reported the figure on Monday citing accounting documents. It said the main reason for the profit was the sale last year of Framatome's shares in holding company Cie de Navigation Mixte.
"We have no comment," a spokeswoman for the company told Reuters. She said the company would release its results in June.
In 1995, the company earned 663 million francs.
The paper reported Framatome's turnover fell to 15 billion francs in 1996 from 17.9 billion in 1995 because it did not build any new nuclear plants.
Two other reasons for the rise in profit were better results at its Cezus unit and stronger performance of its information networking business, Les Echos said.
Framatome is 40-percent controlled by Alcatel Alsthom .
